framework_lessons: Separate cash returns from operating resilience.
assessment: Energy over discretionary and the CVS capital-return timetable were well supported. Amazon over Apple, Roku and the broad China-floor judgment disappointed. The limited-Fed-tightening thesis was contradicted by the following policy cycle. CVS illustrates why a correct dividend forecast can coexist with weak relative stock performance and deteriorating insurance economics.
